data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fahda means 'guide' or 'helper'. In Islamic history, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was called Fahd or Fahdah because he was a guide for his community and a helper for all of mankind. The name Fahda carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fahda usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_urdu.name: فہدہ
